narrative.overview: Cyath balances warm physical tactility with high-performance digital wellness tracking. Instead of cold biometric charts or sterile neon glass, the interface evokes a master craftsperson's workshop: warm Japanese parchment paper, deep pine evergreen inks, golden kintsugi repair seams, and an archival guild ledger tome bound with wax-sealed receipts.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Parchment Grounding: Textured ivory and cream backgrounds (#FAF8F5, #FFFDF9).
Deep Evergreen & Sage Typography: Natural evergreen ink (#1A3629) providing calm, authoritative contrast.
Dual-Geometry Discipline: Rounded cards (rounded-2xl) for daily tools; sharp book edges (rounded-none) for archival tome.
Uncompromised Pixel Art: High-fidelity 16-bit sprites rendered with crisp edge rules (image-rendering: pixelated).
Tactile Web Audio Rituals: Rich synthesized auditory feedback for blips, rustles, confirms, and seals.

rules.name: The Rarity of Gold Rule
rules.body: Golden Kintsugi accents are reserved exclusively for earned achievements, streak repairs, and verified wax seals. They never appear as casual background decoration.

rules.name: The No-Pitch-Black Rule
rules.body: Pure #000000 is strictly avoided for typography. Deep Evergreen (#1A3629) serves as the darkest ink, creating a softer, more organic reading posture.

rules.name: The Monospace Discipline Rule
rules.body: All numerical measurements, XP counters, timestamps, and hotkey accelerators are rendered in JetBrains Mono to preserve tabular vertical alignment across updates.

rules.name: The Deboss-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Secondary containers and inactive states use recessed wells (bg-[#FAF8F5] with a 1px border) rather than floating elevation, giving the workspace a carved, physical feel.

dos: Do preserve crisp pixel edges (image-rendering: pixelated) on all trophy relics, food plates, and island assets.
Do wrap continuous animations in motion-safe: utility prefixes to protect users with vestibular sensitivity.
Do provide screen-reader accessible labels on all natural language inputs and interactive receipt buttons.
Do maintain tabular monospace fonts for all numerical macros, dates, and level statistics.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000000) for text or backgrounds; use Japanese Evergreen (#1A3629) and Parchment (#FAF8F5).
Don't use generic AI side-tab borders on card containers; use dedicated structural elements for book spines.
Don't use em-dashes or en-dashes in UI copy or documentation; use clear punctuation.
Don't let offscreen drawer box-shadows bleed onto the canvas; always apply opacity-0 invisible when closed.
